s01768.summary: Five jurors sit with feet on rungs in a flooded jury room, tired and bickering.
Hattie confiscates Roman's flask and calls a show of hands, three to two guilty.
Beverly and Estelle argue over whether an apology equals guilt.
The foreman's chair is pulled out with a wet gown folded on it.
Sunil miscounts five jurors, and his motionless reflection stares back; he changes his vote.

s02091.summary: Bingo players squabble over a moved dauber and imaginary lanes.
Loretta reveals she is angry about Tuesday, when Elijah told the priest she spread rumors.
Loretta admits telling eleven people the roof fund was short four thousand dollars.
Elijah admits a clerical error he never corrected, then apologizes repeatedly.
Loretta forgives him, and they start the game, Loretta winning the first number.

s01530_0.summary: Nadezhda plays a voice memo of herself directing her to check a car trunk.
Under the felt lining she finds a taped flash drive.
The recorded voice forbids the elevator, which is climbing to her floor.
Footsteps close in; she smashes the phone and sprints for the stairwell.

s01630.summary: Bouchard logs unchanging barometer readings at an isolated weather station.
On the radio, Bouchard reports nothing at all while Fenwick says hold position.
Bouchard jokes to the empty room, writes no change, and vows to paint the wall.

s01968.summary: Ezra hauls up mud from the well shaft while Mercy holds the rope.
Land agent Ansel rides in and says the bank now owns the claim.
Ansel leaves a paper and gives them until sundown.
Mercy insists there is water and begs an hour; Ansel grants it.
Ansel waits in the wagon's shade as Ezra descends and Mercy hauls.

s00073.summary: A flood-ruined casino serves as a courtroom, with a roulette bench and nervous prosecutor.
Maxwell accuses the defendant of opening the sluice gates; Clementine's objection is sustained.
Maxwell calls the night watchman, but the bailiff finds no one at the door.
Clementine dismantles the State's case and moves to dismiss.
The judge spins the roulette wheel, calls red seventeen, and dismisses the case.

s01254.summary: Outlaws wake at a canyon camp as Augustus spots smoke on the horizon.
Augustus counts eleven riders against their four, and Elijah lights his match slowly.
Pepper proposes riding away; Elijah says they would be seen, and she resigns.
Tobias wakes and Elijah hands him the unlit cigarette for after.
As hoofbeats rumble, Pepper and Tobias both insist the boy has a right to a gun.
Elijah orders coffee on, so if they die they die warm, and the fire catches.

s00409.summary: Sunny and Booker face off at nine to eight in a basement ping-pong final.
Booker ties it nine all, and Sunny gives him the serve to win clean.
A fierce rally ends with Sunny's diving return clipping the edge for the win.
The room erupts; Booker graciously congratulates Sunny, and Francesca teases him.

s01425.summary: Curlers face the last stone at six all in a converted cathedral.
Bernie coaxes Maeve to admit fear; the team trades small jokes about the ice.
Desmond throws his stone, and June and Raffi sweep it to rest short of the ring.
Maeve throws her last stone, which drifts under the rose window almost to the pin.
Bernie measures a quarter-inch loss and orders them to prepare for an extra end.

s02182.summary: Judge Whitlock warns both counsel against another outburst in a packed courtroom.
Rosalind testifies the anaesthesia log was blank for forty minutes and names Dr. Stroud.
Oyelowo cross-examines Rosalind on responsibility for the log; she stands firm.
Oyelowo asks why she waited eleven months; she says no one asked.

s01268.summary: Exes Imani and Fernando meet awkwardly at a riverboat wedding reception.
Their fingers meet on a champagne flute and they freeze.
Gloria and Abel exchange a glance and ceremoniously cut the cake.

s00298.summary: Cyprian argues with a furious customer whose toaster exploded.
Aggie sees a toast-shaped hole and tells Moe not to say it's covered.
Cyprian offers a new toaster; Rosamund demands a ceiling.
Aggie takes the headset and placates Rosamund with a complimentary hat that doesn't exist.

s01144.summary: Eliza develops a glass plate in the red-lit darkroom with her apprentice.
The plate shows a pale shape over the widow's shoulder, her husband dead eleven years.
Eliza has the plate fixed; Mrs. Whitlock watches as the shape stays.

s01108_1.summary: They tumble into the corridor and brace the door against a thudding creature.
Loretta finds a brass key and locks the bolt, stopping the thudding.
A tiny voice under the door begs them not to leave; none answer.

s00728.summary: Millicent records a dictation cylinder naming the true ledger in the lower drawer.
A shadow at the door; she hides the cylinder in a locked drawer and pockets the key.
Millicent smiles brightly and invites the man in, saying she has just finished.

s00485.summary: Derby players get a game plan from Zeke and joke about holding the line.
Zeke privately tells Rosie his knee is done and she gets the whistle next season.
Announced by Bix, Rosie and Zeke go in together.

s01466.summary: Four strangers ride an elevator that stalls between floors.
Jocelyn swats Nadine's phone away when she tries to call security.
Lights go out, and Jocelyn aims a pistol at Teodoro for missing his floor.
The elevator drops; Teodoro grapples Jocelyn's wrist and the gun fires, then doors open on concrete.

s00617.summary: Oksana notices a tunnel wall rippling as if breathing on the monitors.
Oksana delays calling it in; she says it's not a fault line and she doesn't know.
A wet crack runs through the walls and rocks open with pale light on every feed.
Oksana orders crews to Lock Two, gets static, and has Josie pull the alarm.
The seam splits to reveal a vast bright cavern before the cameras die.
Oksana orders everyone topside and the shafts flooded despite the risk to her job.

s01903.summary: Nadia walks the cryo-bay reporting temperatures to sleepers who cannot hear.
Nadia sees Pod 411's frost thin and its sleeper's eyelid flicker.
The AI logs an anomaly, Felix drops his thermos, and the eyelid opens.

s00525.summary: Soldiers in a snowy bell tower count enemy troops in the orchard.
A footstep sends four rifles swinging, but it is Mother Agathe with a kettle.
She offers tea and says it won't poison them before the second cup; Hadley laughs.

s02340.summary: A funeral-themed speakeasy fills with tense patrons, including a banker and gangsters.
Horatio tells Eugenia to smile and not look at the door; Dubois orders the cellar locked.
Inspector Blackwood descends the stairs, and Dubois answers him evenly.
Dominic reaches into his coat; the room tenses until Blackwood lays down his badge.
Blackwood says he's here to pay respects, and Dubois pours him a glass.

s00218.summary: Two agents and an informant wait nervously in a basement safehouse.
Knocking in the pipes turns out to be Morse, which Teddie brushes off as wind.
Bastian listens at the wall, hears someone behind it, and Renata draws her weapon.
A fist punches through the wall, Renata fires, and Teddie bolts upstairs.
